items.title: Netflix Wraps Upfront, Volume 'Nearly Doubled'
items.summary: Netflix says it has "nearly doubled our ad commitments this year." In a release, Netflix President of Advertising Amy Reinhard says this was in line with expectations. She did not provide specific details on volume or pricing gains.

items.title: Down but Not Out: Analysts See 40% Upside in Netflix After the Slide
items.summary: Netflix has shed more than a third of its value in a year, yet analysts keep stacking up buy ratings with price targets that sit far above Wall Street consensus. The question is whether the sell-off exposed a genuine crack or handed patient investors a rare entry point into a cash machine with an ad business barely off the launch pad.

items.title: Warren Buffett Bought Alphabet Stock Last Year. He Might Buy This Megacap Stock Next, Says a Wall Street Expert.
items.summary: With Netflix trading at its cheapest valuation in three years, the streaming stock could pique Warren Buffett's interest.

items.title: Why Is Disney So Much Cheaper Than Netflix? This Is the Only Answer I Can Think Of.
items.summary: Disney looks like the value play with improving fundamentals, while Netflix remains the premium-priced choice for investors who want a cleaner, more predictable streaming growth story.

items.title: Netflix Looks Attractive to Short-Put Players - a 2.0% One Month Income Yield
items.summary: Netflix stock looks attractive to value investors, especially to out-of-the-money (OTM) short-put investors. For example, a 2.0% yield for one month is available on a put option with a 5% lower strike price.

items.title: Wall Street Cheers Disney’s Report. Here’s Our New Price Target
items.summary: Disney just posted its fifth straight earnings beat and sent streaming profits soaring, but the stock still sits nearly 10% in the red for the year. Our model puts a specific number on where shares go from here and why Wall Street's celebration may still be underselling the real opportunity.
